definitions.explanation: identification; an identifier used to verify identity or access accounts

examples.japanese: IDとパスワードを{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。
examples.english: Please enter your ID and password.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}IDを{忘|わす}れてしまった。
{会員|かいいん}IDは{登録|とうろく}{時|じ}にメールで{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: Your member ID will be sent by email when you register.

notes:
ID is the abbreviation for Identification, pronounced アイディー in Japanese. It commonly refers to usernames, account identifiers, or identification numbers.

COMPOUNDS:
- {社員|しゃいん}ID (employee ID)
- {会員|かいいん}ID (member ID)
- ユーザーID (user ID)
- {学生|がくせい}ID (student ID)
- IDカード (ID card)

DIGITAL USAGE:
- ログインID (login ID)
- Apple ID, Google ID (service-specific IDs)
- ID{認証|にんしょう} (ID verification)

PHYSICAL ID:
For physical identification documents, {身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ} is the native term, though IDカード is also used.

ID PAYMENT:
In Japan, "iD" (stylized) is also a major contactless payment service by NTTドコモ, which can cause confusion with the general term.

REGISTER: Neutral. Standard vocabulary in digital and business contexts.
